title: Flat single-object pairing pullback after symmetry
statement: Let B be a symmetric monoidal Grothendieck abelian coefficient category with functorial flat resolutions and flat-preserving etale inverse image. Assume the derived inverse-image tensor comparison preserves symmetry. For any ordinary pairing square L tensor M -> P on Y and L' tensor M' -> P' on X, with L and L' flat, its flat single-object derived pairing, preceded by symmetry to reverse the factors, commutes with derived pullback and the single-object comparison maps. The other factors and the pairing maps are arbitrary.

source.place: Degree-zero evaluation pullback, symmetry/naturality step; Stacks Tags 06YQ and 06YU.

proof.text: Use the pullback field of etaleSingleFunctor_monoidalCompatibility to lift the ordinary pairing square. Compose with the assumed symmetry square. Naturality of the derived symmetry moves both factor maps through it; associativity of composition gives the displayed negative-first square. All these coherence calculations take place at abstract coefficients, before specialization to ModuleCat.

theorem flatSinglePairing_symmetricPullback
    (B : Type uB) [Category.{u + 1} B] [Abelian B]
    [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{u + 1} B] [MonoidalCategory B] [MonoidalPreadditive B]
    [SymmetricCategory B] [MonoidalClosed B] [Abelian.HasFunctorialFlatResolution B]
    [UpperStarPreservesFlat B] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hsym : ∀ K M : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology B),
      (upperStar B f).leftDerivedFunctor.map
        (((derivedTensorSymmetry B Y).hom.app K).app M) ≫
        ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison B f).app M).app K =
      ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison B f).app K).app M ≫
        ((derivedTensorSymmetry B X).hom.app
          ((upperStar B f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj K)).app
          ((upperStar B f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj M))
    (L M P : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology B)
    (L' M' P' : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology B)
    (hL : ObjectProperty.flat L) (hL' : ObjectProperty.flat L')
    (q : L ⊗ M ⟶ P) (q' : L' ⊗ M' ⟶ P')
    (l : (upperStar B f).obj L ⟶ L')
    (m : (upperStar B f).obj M ⟶ M')
    (p : (upperStar B f).obj P ⟶ P')
    (w : (upperStar B f).map q ≫ p =
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ (upperStar B f) L M ≫
        (l ⊗ₘ m) ≫ q') :
    (upperStar B f).leftDerivedFunctor.map
      (((derivedTensorSymmetry B Y).hom.app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)).app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj L) ≫
        singleFunctorFlatPairing L M P hL q) ≫ singleFunctorPullbackMap f p =
      ((leftDerivedUpperStarTensorComparison B f).app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M)).app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj L) ≫
      ((derivedTensor B X).obj ((upperStar B f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M))).map (singleFunctorPullbackMap f l) ≫
      ((derivedTensor B X).map (singleFunctorPullbackMap f m)).app _ ≫
      ((derivedTensorSymmetry B X).hom.app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M')).app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj L') ≫
        singleFunctorFlatPairing L' M' P' hL' q'
